sourceChecks.text: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 人口調査と宿営配置に登場するシェルミエルは、ツリシャダイの子と記されます。

sourceChecks.text: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 人口調査と宿営配置に登場するシェルミエルは、ツリシャダイの子と記されます。

sourceChecks.text: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 人口調査と宿営配置に登場するシェルミエルは、ツリシャダイの子と記されます。

sourceChecks.text: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.
